title: Volcanoes of Mexico (timed)
intro: 10 volcanoes of Mexico, one after another. You have 45 seconds for each place; at zero your marker is locked in. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Chichon, El
rounds.fact: Chichon, El is a tuff cone; the latest significant eruption recorded for it in the source data was in 1982. The data places it in Mexico.
